note: Real export shipments are documented, not merely claimed: 4 outbound India->Russia air consignments to VELES OOO (Sheremetyevo) dated 2025-06-27 (x3, B/L 3080715) and 2025-11-19 (B/L 9933710), plus 1 inbound UK consignment from ADAM INTERNATIONAL TRADE L.T.D. (B/L 3105473, 2025-11-03). The company therefore operates as a two-way trader, not a manufacturer: the goods are third-party branded items (MACHINE DISPLAY DP6XXTM SERIES, PRESSURE TRANSDUCER, FEEDER MOTOR ADAPTOR SHAFT) moving between UK/Russia counterparties through Delhi Air, which is consistent with role 'trader' rather than 'manufacturer'. Declared HS 853710 is correct for the 2025-11-19 shipment (85371090) but the same counterparty relationship also carries 90262000, 73182400 and 84831099, so the company is a multi-HS trader and a single HS code does not describe its trade. Revenue and export volume in value terms: null - ImportKey free view exposes shipment counts (16) and dates but no values, and no financial filing was accessible. Domestic supply evidence: not found in accessible sources, status left 'unknown' rather than 'none_found' because all registry sources were blocked (403) and the search backend was down, so the negative could not be established. No rejection grounds: the entity appears active with shipments as recent as 2025-11-19.
